about: The second look after Claude's review, per review kind: the models to try, first choice first, one per family (gpt-<model> through Codex, grok-<model>, opencode/<model> free only), and the day the pick was last checked against Lex's Codex default, `grok models` and `opencode models`. GPT may review since 2026-11-09 (Lex); Claude Opus stays the main reviewer. GPT is never used for a docs-only change, and once per PR; a later look on that PR goes to the next model, except as the last resort after the free OpenCode model fails (Lex, 2026-11-12). `effort` gives a model its effort. One table for every project; the lead updates it when new models appear.
